policy.startup: parent spawn-to-reap monotonic wall time; GNU time supervisor and blocking wait4; receipts outside span; OS cache not flushed
policy.cold: unique empty application cache; shared runtime build image retained; normal Node without persistent compile cache
policy.hot: prewarmed scriptw disk cache; repeated new Node process without equivalent persistent code cache
policy.execution: compile once per case/process; equal warmup counts; fresh Store or vm Context; output/completion included; setup outside execution span
policy.memory: GNU time kernel high-water RSS covers the runtime child including compilation, warmups and caches; excludes inherited Python launcher high-water; no subtraction
policy.prime: SCRIPTW_WASM_TRACE=1 only for unmeasured startup priming; record whether embedded native runtime was admitted
policy.heap: Wasmtime GC capacity is reserved space, V8 heapUsed is process-wide used space; not equivalent live JS byte counts
policy.sampler: existing Wasmtime invocation RSS sampling every 10ms plus endpoints; Node memoryUsage endpoints; instrumentation is part of the measured configuration
policy.gc: normal runtime GC and V8 tiering; no forced collections; no unavailable Wasmtime allocation/live-heap/GC-pause claims
policy.limitations: single cloud VM; no OS cache flush, DVFS control, statistical significance or conformance acceptance

iteration_comparison.interpretation: Observed median ratios; no statistical significance or automatic acceptance claim.

cache_conditioning: An initial selected integer report prepopulates the shared checked execution cache. Its compilation/allocator peak is excluded from the full baseline and from the matched iteration pair. Cold application caches remain unique and empty.

compiler_fingerprint_controls.scope: Standalone Rust integration test compiled with the release sha2 dependency; no full Engine native test rebuild

diagnostics.initial_run: target/performance-memory-baseline-20261021/report.json is retained as an incoherent-build diagnostic, not the healthy baseline. It preceded GNU time accounting and could inherit the Python launcher RSS floor.
diagnostics.stale_build_script: A reused custom-build executable still compiled an old source-exclusion inventory. Both current build scripts attest their compiled fingerprint module against the checkout; the old executable paths were regenerated without cleaning compiler dependencies.

limitations: One local cloud machine, seven samples, ordinary product policy; no statistical significance or calibrated T25 acceptance.
Whole-child high-water RSS includes compilation, warmups, host and caches. Shared execution caches were conditioned before the full run. OS caches were not flushed.
Wasmtime invocation RSS is sampled at 10 ms plus endpoints. V8 RSS and heapUsed are process-wide endpoints; neither is a per-workload live allocation measurement.
Wasmtime GC capacity and V8 used heap are different metrics. Wasmtime exposes no public live-byte/allocation/collection/pause counter here.
The three-sample iteration pair uses the same source and demonstrates workflow/repeatability, not a compiler optimization.
No new full Test262 or full current-source native acceptance run is implied.
Executable ELF images and private caches are not embedded; reports bind executable SHA-256 to Cargo producer records.
